data.gender_notes: Fakhri is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fakhri refers to the pride or honour that comes from one's faith, actions, and character. It is a value that is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and is considered a desirable trait. The name Fakhri carries the meaning “Pride, Honour, Glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fakhri usually hope their child will grow to embody pride, honour, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is proud of their relationship with Allah and their adherence to Islamic principles.
data.etymology: Fakhri belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pride, Honour, Glory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhri total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فخري
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفخر، الشخص ذو المجد و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فخري مشتق من الجذر الفخري، و يعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالمجد و العزة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و الكرامة، و يعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: فخری
in_urdu.meaning: فخر سے متعلق، عزت و شان والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: فخری نام عربی زبان کے الفخر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو عزت و شان کا مالک ہو، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں عزت و احترام کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے، خصوصاً جنوبی ایشیاء میں

in_hindi.name: फख़री

in_hindi.long_meaning: फख़री नाम का अर्थ है फख्र से मاخोझ, जो सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा को दर्शाता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण माने जाते हैं और अक्सर बच्चों के नामकरण में चुना जाता है

in_pashto.name: فخري
